entities.summary: Sırçalı Medrese is a 13th-century medrese in Konya, Turkey, that served as the capital of the Anatolian Seljuq state. Primary sources indicate that around twenty-four Seljuq Madrasas were built in this city. Seven madrasas still stand in Konya, preserving their architectural heritage.
